mapper.sql: select p.product_id, p.merchant_id, m.company_name as merchant_name, p.category_id, c.category_code, c.category_name, p.brand_name, p.product_name, p.subtitle, p.detail, p.cover_url, p.price, p.stock, coalesce(( select sum(oi.quantity) from shop_order_item oi inner join shop_order o on o.order_id = oi.order_id and o.del_flag = '0' where oi.product_id = p.product_id and o.status in ('PAID', 'SHIPPED', 'RECEIVED', 'REFUNDING') ), 0) as sales_count, p.status as product_status, p.del_flag, p.create_time as product_create_time, p.update_time as product_update_time, p.remark, pc.status as certification_status, pc.certification_no, pc.source_type as certification_source_type, pc.supplier_name as certification_supplier_name, pc.origin_place as certification_origin_place, pc.shipping_place as certification_shipping_place, pc.match_type as certification_match_type, pc.proof_type as certification_proof_type, pc.public_summary as certification_public_summary, pc.merchant_reason as certification_merchant_reason, pc.passed_at as certification_passed_at, pc.expires_at as certification_expires_at from shop_product p inner join shop_merchant m on m.merchant_id = p.merchant_id and m.del_flag = '0' inner join shop_product_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id left join shop_product_certification pc on pc.product_id = p.product_id and pc.merchant_id = p.merchant_id and pc.current_flag = '1'
mapper.select: select category_id, category_code, category_name, category_sort, status as category_status, create_time as category_create_time, update_time as category_update_time from shop_product_category where status = '0' order by category_sort, category_id

select category_id, category_code, category_name, category_sort, status as category_status, create_time as category_create_time, update_time as category_update_time from shop_product_category where category_id = #{categoryId}
mapper.update: update shop_product_category set category_name = #{categoryName}, category_sort = #{categorySort}, status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where category_id = #{categoryId} and category_code in ('CATEGORY_1', 'CATEGORY_2', 'CATEGORY_3', 'CATEGORY_4')
mapper.select:
p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and p.del_flag = '0'
and (p.product_name like concat('%', #{query.productName}, '%') or p.subtitle like concat('%', #{query.productName}, '%') or p.brand_name like concat('%', #{query.productName}, '%'))
and p.category_id = #{query.categoryId} and p.status = #{query.status}
and exists ( select 1 from shop_trial_campaign active_trial where active_trial.product_id = p.product_id and active_trial.status = 'RECRUITING' )
order by p.product_id desc
where p.product_id = #{productId} and p.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and p.del_flag = '0'

select p.product_id, p.merchant_id, m.company_name as merchant_name, p.category_id, c.category_code, c.category_name, p.brand_name, p.product_name, p.subtitle, p.cover_url, p.price, p.stock, coalesce(( select sum(oi.quantity) from shop_order_item oi inner join shop_order o on o.order_id = oi.order_id and o.del_flag = '0' where oi.product_id = p.product_id and o.status in ('PAID', 'SHIPPED', 'RECEIVED', 'REFUNDING') ), 0) as sales_count, p.status as product_status, pc.status as certification_status, pc.certification_no, pc.source_type as certification_source_type, case when char_length(pc.supplier_name) <= 2 then concat(left(pc.supplier_name, 1), '*') else concat(left(pc.supplier_name, 2), '***', right(pc.supplier_name, 2)) end as certification_supplier_name, pc.origin_place as certification_origin_place, pc.shipping_place as certification_shipping_place, pc.match_type as certification_match_type, pc.proof_type as certification_proof_type, pc.public_summary as certification_public_summary, null as certification_merchant_reason, pc.passed_at as certification_passed_at, pc.expires_at as certification_expires_at from shop_product p inner join shop_merchant m on m.merchant_id = p.merchant_id and m.del_flag = '0' inner join shop_product_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id left join shop_product_certification pc on pc.product_id = p.product_id and pc.merchant_id = p.merchant_id and pc.current_flag = '1' and pc.status = 'PASSED' and pc.expires_at > sysdate()
p.status = 'ON_SALE' and p.del_flag = '0' and m.audit_status = 'APPROVED' and m.status = '0' and c.status = '0' and p.category_id = #{categoryId}
and ( p.product_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.subtitle like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.brand_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or m.company_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.category_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or cast(p.product_id as char) = #{keyword} )
order by case when pc.certification_id is not null then 0 else 1 end, p.product_id desc

select p.product_id, p.merchant_id, m.company_name as merchant_name, p.category_id, c.category_code, c.category_name, p.brand_name, p.product_name, p.subtitle, p.detail, p.cover_url, p.price, p.stock, coalesce(( select sum(oi.quantity) from shop_order_item oi inner join shop_order o on o.order_id = oi.order_id and o.del_flag = '0' where oi.product_id = p.product_id and o.status in ('PAID', 'SHIPPED', 'RECEIVED', 'REFUNDING') ), 0) as sales_count, p.status as product_status, p.del_flag, p.create_time as product_create_time, p.update_time as product_update_time, p.remark, pc.status as certification_status, pc.certification_no, pc.source_type as certification_source_type, case when char_length(pc.supplier_name) <= 2 then concat(left(pc.supplier_name, 1), '*') else concat(left(pc.supplier_name, 2), '***', right(pc.supplier_name, 2)) end as certification_supplier_name, pc.origin_place as certification_origin_place, pc.shipping_place as certification_shipping_place, pc.match_type as certification_match_type, pc.proof_type as certification_proof_type, pc.public_summary as certification_public_summary, null as certification_merchant_reason, pc.passed_at as certification_passed_at, pc.expires_at as certification_expires_at from shop_product p inner join shop_merchant m on m.merchant_id = p.merchant_id and m.del_flag = '0' inner join shop_product_category c on c.category_id = p.category_id left join shop_product_certification pc on pc.product_id = p.product_id and pc.merchant_id = p.merchant_id and pc.current_flag = '1' and pc.status = 'PASSED' and pc.expires_at > sysdate() where p.product_id = #{productId} and p.status = 'ON_SALE' and p.del_flag = '0' and m.audit_status = 'APPROVED' and m.status = '0' and c.status = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into shop_product (merchant_id, category_id, brand_name, product_name, subtitle, detail, cover_url, price, stock, sales_count, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{merchantId}, #{categoryId}, #{brandName}, #{productName}, #{subtitle}, #{detail}, #{coverUrl}, #{price}, #{stock}, 0, 'DRAFT', '0', #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{updateBy}, sysdate())
mapper.update: update shop_product set category_id = #{categoryId}, brand_name = #{brandName}, product_name = #{productName}, subtitle = #{subtitle}, detail = #{detail}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, price = #{price}, stock = #{stock}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where product_id = #{productId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and del_flag = '0'
update shop_product set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where product_id = #{productId} and merchant_id = #{merchantId} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into shop_product_image (product_id, image_type, image_url, image_sort, create_time) values (#{productId}, #{imageType}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageSort}, sysdate())
